0022600211.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (5-4, winners of three straight and 5th in the East) in this 11th game of the Bucks' season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost their season series 1-2, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27. Tyler Herro is listed as day-to-day with a knee bruise for the Bucks, and Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury for the Knicks, and both are game-time decisions.
